comments.author: Randall Bohn
comments.text: Moved cal3.asm, clock.asm, fib.asm, and renamed dull-boy.asm to dullboy.asm into ./sd.

title: Fix clean target to remove bin/monitor.static
description: makefile clean target removes bin/monitor-static but the built artifact is bin/monitor.static. Update clean to remove the correct filename.

title: Implement monitor stack commands
description: Implement monitor stack commands per docs/monitor-stack-ops.md: stack config/status/peek/push/pop/reset, bare-octal push, bounds handling with overflow/underflow errors + discard remaining input.
close_reason: Implemented monitor stack commands with default 00170-00177 stack, bare-octal push, and overflow/underflow handling.

title: Investigate magtape sense test fail
description: ./tests/pdp8_tests fails: Assertion failed: READY flag set (Test: magtape sense).

title: Task engine with control page and round-robin scheduling
description: Implement task engine: each task has private instruction pointer and stack pointer, modeled as a state machine. Each task has a control page. Tasks execute round-robin via task table at 0160-0167.

title: plan stack operations for monitor
close_reason: Documented a plan for monitor stack operations and referenced it in the programmer guide.

title: Monitor parser: tokenized word-at-a-time commands
description: Enhance monitor command parser to process one word at a time, executing commands and consuming required arguments from the current line. Example: '5 6 . .' should push 5, push 6, print TOS, print TOS. Commands that take arguments should read them up to end-of-line.

title: Decide whether to link host binaries against factory/libpdp8.so
description: bin/monitor, bin/pdp8v, and bin/pdp8-filter depend on $(FACTORY_LIB) but filter it out when linking, so they compile emulator sources directly. Clarify intent: link against shared lib or keep sources-only, and update makefile accordingly.
close_reason: Linked host binaries against factory/libpdp8.so and rebuilt.

title: update documentation in ./docs
close_reason: Updated programmer guide to use factory/libpdp8.so and note rpath linkage.

title: Update docs for monitor command aliases and stack shortcuts
description: Document new monitor aliases (q quit, m/x mem, . stack pop) and stack behavior in relevant docs.
close_reason: Documented monitor command aliases and stack shortcut in the programmer guide and stack ops doc.

title: Block editor on tape with edit/load commands
description: Implement tape-based block editor. Blocks live on a tape; support reading blocks into memory. Provide CLI/monitor commands: '<n> edit' to edit block n, '<n> load' to compile block n (e.g., '13 edit', '13 load').
